summary: Phase D dialog-replacement testing complete. Verified all 5 UI flows on the public preview URL: (1) Wings delete ConfirmDialog, (2) Residents reject ConfirmDialog (dialog-open+cancel path only; no pending residents to fully confirm), (3) Maintenance Exclude-Flat ReasonDialog, (4) Maintenance Cancel-Bill ReasonDialog + restore, (5) Notices delete ConfirmDialog. Zero native window.confirm/window.prompt dialogs fired across the entire run (page.on('dialog') listener registered — 0 hits). Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL regression bug in MaintenanceBills.js line 295 introduced by the dialog refactor — the Cancel button in the bills table was wired to handleCancelBill(bill.id) directly (passing bill_id as the reason and leaving cancelBillId=null) instead of setCancelBillId(bill.id), which prevented the ReasonDialog from ever opening and triggered a 'Bill not found' toast. After the one-line fix, the full cancel+reason+restore flow works. Also had to seed the test environment because the admin user 8888888888 was missing from the DB (only platform_owner is auto-seeded).

critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceBills.js: handleCancelBill(reason) is overloaded — it is both (a) the ReasonDialog onSubmit handler receiving reason:string and (b) originally wired as the Cancel button's onClick receiving bill.id. This dual usage caused the reported bug. Suggest renaming to onCancelBillSubmit(reason) for clarity, and keeping only setCancelBillId(bill.id) on the button. (One-line change already applied.)

ConfirmDialogs.js ReasonDialog uses `required` on textarea combined with `disabled={!reason.trim()}` on submit — good UX. However the `handleSubmit` uses e.preventDefault() then calls onSubmit(reason) but does NOT close the dialog itself. Every parent (handleCancelBill, confirmExcludeFlat) must remember to set state to null to close it. Consider having ReasonDialog call onOpenChange(false) after a successful onSubmit to reduce boilerplate and prevent 'stuck open' bugs.

Server-side seed only creates platform_owner; the /app/memory/test_credentials.md advertises 4 accounts but 3 of them (admin, sub-admin, resident) are not idempotently seeded — this is a testing-friction issue that has cost multiple iterations. Suggest a startup seed_demo_data() with is_test_env flag.

MaintenanceBills.js line 232 renders bills-summary only when bills.length > 0, but activeBills-based counts (verifiedCount/paidCount/pendingCount) are computed unconditionally at line 181-186 — harmless but wasted compute; fine.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (Cancel-Bill dialog not opening): During the Phase D refactor from window.prompt to ReasonDialog, the developer added a shared handleCancelBill function whose signature changed from handleCancelBill(billId){const reason=window.prompt(...); api.cancel(billId, reason)} to handleCancelBill(reason){api.cancel(cancelBillId, reason)}. But the Cancel button's onClick was NOT updated — it still calls handleCancelBill(bill.id), which now passes bill.id as reason and uses cancelBillId=null. The API call cancelBill(null, bill.id) returns 404 'Bill not found'. REPRODUCTION: click any cancel-bill-{id} button on the bills table — dialog never opens, red toast 'Bill not found' appears. MITIGATION (applied): change onClick to setCancelBillId(bill.id) so the ReasonDialog opens; handleCancelBill remains the ReasonDialog onSubmit callback.
